maddeler.e:
أقتتل (form VIII)
# أَقْتَتِلُ (ʔaqtatilu) /ʔaq.ta.ti.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# أَقْتَتِلَ (ʔaqtatila) /ʔaq.ta.ti.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# أَقْتَتِلْ (ʔaqtatil) /ʔaq.ta.til/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# أُقْتَتَلُ (ʔuqtatalu) /ʔuq.ta.ta.lu/: f
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
